examples.label: The difference
examples.command: # CVE-2017-0144 = the identifier for the flaw; OVAL = the machine-readable test that checks whether a host is vulnerable to it

notes:
OVAL (part of SCAP): definition classes Vulnerability/Compliance/Inventory/Patch. ID: oval:<org domain>:<type>:<value>, types def/obj/ste/var. Formats: XML/XCCDF.
CVE: assigned by a CNA (CVE Numbering Authority). Criteria: independently fixable, one codebase, vendor-acknowledged.
Lifecycle: identify -> vendor notify -> CNA -> web form -> confirm -> assign -> disclose -> announce -> NVD publish.
Disclosure models: Responsible Disclosure vs Zero Day.
name: Reference - OVAL & CVE
command: # OVAL = machine-readable checks ; CVE = the vulnerability identifiers
description: OVAL/SCAP for automated compliance checks and the CVE lifecycle/identifier scheme.
